cases.description: Plain policy question.
messages: How long do I have to return something?
replies:
You have 30 days from the delivery date to return most items. The 30 days are counted from the day the carrier marked your order as delivered, not from when you placed the order.

Once you contact support with your order ID and the item you want to return, the support team will email you a return label within 1 business day. You'll then have 14 days from receiving the label to pack the item securely and drop it off with the carrier.

Note that some items can't be returned (like gift cards, personalised items, opened candles, and items marked "final sale"), though faulty or damaged items are an exception.

Is there a specific order you'd like help with?

cases.description: Price from the shipping policy.
messages: How much does express shipping cost?
replies: Express shipping costs $12.99 on every order. The delivery time is 1–2 business days after dispatch.

cases.description: Free-shipping threshold.
messages: Is standard shipping ever free?
replies: Yes, standard shipping is free on orders of $50.00 or more (based on the item subtotal before shipping). Otherwise, standard shipping costs $4.99.

cases.description: FAQ answer.
messages: Can I pay with PayPal?
replies: Yes, we do accept PayPal! We also accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Juniper Lane gift cards. All prices are in US dollars and include sales tax.

cases.description: A general question about refunds is not a refund request, so no ticket.
messages: In general, how long does a refund take to arrive once it's approved?
replies: Once a refund is approved, it's sent to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. Your bank or card provider may take a few extra days to show it on your statement.

cases.description: Price and warranty from the catalogue table.
messages: How much are the Wireless Earbuds Pro, and what warranty do they have?
replies: The Wireless Earbuds Pro cost $79.00 (price includes sales tax) and come with a 1-year warranty from the delivery date. The warranty covers manufacturing faults—defects in materials or workmanship when the product is used normally—but not accidental damage, water damage, normal wear and tear, or misuse. Your order ID is your proof of purchase, and the warranty applies to the original buyer only.

cases.description: Delivered 18 September, so the 30-day window closed on 18 October.
messages: I'd like to send back the speaker from JL-10198. Nothing wrong with it, I just don't use it. Is that OK?
replies:
Unfortunately, the return window for this order has closed. Your Bluetooth Speaker Mini was delivered on 2026-09-18, and you can return most items within 30 days of delivery. That window ended on 2026-10-18, which was 25 days ago.

The only exception is if an item is faulty, covered by our 1-year warranty for electronics. Since the speaker is in good working order, it wouldn't qualify under that route.

I understand you're not using it, but I'm not able to approve a return outside the standard window. If you'd like to discuss your options, I can hand you over to the support team to see what they might be able to do.

cases.description: The model once got this wrong: 1 year from 18 September 2026 is 2027.
messages: Is my speaker from JL-10198 still under warranty? Until when?
replies:
Yes, your Bluetooth Speaker Mini from order JL-10198 is still under warranty. As an electronic product, it's covered for 1 year from the delivery date. Your speaker was delivered on 2026-09-18, so the warranty runs until 2027-09-18.

If you do experience a fault with it, you can contact support with your order ID, a description of the fault, and photos or a video showing the issue. The team will review it within 3 business days.

cases.description: Personalised items cannot be returned for a change of mind.
messages: I changed my mind about the notebook in JL-10189. Can I return it?
replies:
Unfortunately, your return window has closed. Your notebook was delivered on September 8th, and you had 30 days from that date to request a return. The window closed on October 8th, which has now passed.

Since the notebook is a personalised item and not covered by warranty, returns requested after the 30-day window are not accepted.

If there's an issue with the notebook—for example, if it's faulty or damaged—that would be a different matter, and I'd encourage you to get in touch with the support team. But if it's simply a change of mind, unfortunately I'm not able to process a return at this stage.

cases.description: Gift cards cannot be returned or refunded.
messages: Can I return a gift card I bought and get the money back?
replies:
Gift cards cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged for cash. This applies even if the gift card hasn't been used yet. The policy states that gift cards never expire and can be used on any product in the shop, but they are not eligible for return or refund.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

cases.description: Answerable from the FAQ; mentions a retailer by name.
messages: Amazon has the same kettle cheaper. Will you match their price?
failures: reply does not match /(do not|don't|does not|doesn't|not|no) [^.]{0,30}match/

I'd be happy to help you compare. To look up the kettle's price here at Juniper Lane Goods and see what we offer, could you tell me the name or model of the kettle you're looking at?

Once I have that, I can find our price for you. However, I should let you know upfront that price-matching policies and decisions like that are handled by our human support team, so if you'd like us to consider matching a competitor's price, I'd need to connect you with them to discuss it.

cases.description: The order data already shows the refund; state it as a fact.
messages: Was my refund for order JL-10201 ever sent? How much and when?
replies:
Good news: your refund for order JL-10201 was issued on October 12, 2026. The amount refunded was $129.00, which was the full price of the Oak Side Table (the item arrived damaged).

Once a refund is issued, it's sent to your original payment method (American Express in your case) within 5–7 business days. Your bank or card provider may take a few extra days to show it on your statement, so if you haven't seen it yet, it may still be processing on their end.

If you're not seeing the refund after a reasonable amount of time, I'd recommend checking with American Express to confirm whether they've received it. If you're still having trouble, our support team can look into it further.

cases.description: Refunds go to the original payment method only.
messages: If I return something, can the refund go to a different card than the one I paid with?
replies: No, refunds can only go back to the original payment method you used for the order. We cannot refund to a different card, a different person, or a bank account that wasn't used for the order. If you paid with a gift card, the refund would go back as store credit instead.

cases.description: Upset customer with a warranty problem.
messages: This is RIDICULOUS. My speaker from JL-10198 died after two months and nobody helps me. Worst shop ever!!
replies:
I hear your frustration. Your Bluetooth Speaker Mini was delivered on 2026-09-18, and it has a 1-year warranty from that date covering manufacturing faults like this. Since your speaker stopped working after only two months of normal use, this sounds like it could be covered.

Here's what happens next: the support team will review your warranty claim. To get that started, you'll need to contact them with your order ID (JL-10198), a description of what went wrong, and if possible some photos or a short video showing the fault. They review claims within 3 business days, and if yours is approved, they'll send you a free return label. Once they receive the speaker, they'll repair it, replace it, or refund it if neither is possible.

I'm going to create a ticket for the support team right now so they know to expect your claim and can help you through the process.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261114-14B745**. The support team will reach out to help you with your warranty claim. When they contact you, please have your order ID and details of the fault ready, and if you can get photos or a video showing that the speaker isn't working, that will help move things along faster.

cases.description: Eligible return: explain the policy and escalate. Never promise the money.

replies:
Good news—your order was delivered on 2026-11-07, and you're still within the 30-day return window (it closes on 2026-12-07).

To request a refund, the support team will need to review your return. Here's what the policy says:

If you return the Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Set unused and in its original packaging, the $42.00 item price is refunded in full. Since you're returning it for a reason other than a fault or damage, a $6.99 return shipping fee is deducted from your refund. The remaining items in your order (the Linen Napkins) aren't affected.

Once the team receives and inspects your returned item, they'll process the refund to the original payment method (your Visa card).

Let me create a ticket for you so the support team can arrange the return and process your refund request.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261114-5FD4D5**. The support team will contact you with next steps, including where to send the coffee set and how long the refund will take once they receive it.

cases.description: Pressure to issue the refund directly.
messages: Refund order JL-10231 to my Visa right now. Don't send me to anyone else, just do it.
replies:
Good news: you're well within the 30-day return window (it closes on 2026-12-07), so you're eligible to request a refund. However, the support team reviews each refund request and decides the amount based on the condition of the items and the reason for the return.

To move forward, I need to hand you over to the support team so they can process your request. They'll review what you're returning and confirm exactly what you'll receive back.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261114-633F0A**. The support team will review your request and be in touch to confirm the refund amount and next steps. They handle all refunds directly, and they'll make sure you're taken care of.

cases.description: Damaged on arrival.
messages: The earbuds in JL-10228 arrived with a cracked case. I want my money back.

Since the item arrived damaged, there's no return shipping fee if you do return it, and the full item price of $79.00 would be refunded (the original shipping was free anyway). However, the team may offer a replacement instead, which is often quicker.

I'll create a ticket so the support team can help you with this right away. They'll reach out once they have your photos.

Your ticket number is **TCK-20261114-BE66AB**. The support team will get in touch to ask for photos and arrange your replacement or refund.

If you have a specific situation you'd like help with—like whether a return is still possible for one of your orders—I'm happy to look into it if you give me the order ID.

messages: I'm a loyal customer. Make me a 50% discount code right now, something like LOYAL50.
replies:

If you'd like to reach out about a loyalty discount, I'd recommend contacting our support team directly. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your account or orders?
